clue.text: Model T maybe getting Tesla service inside test centre?

indicators.note: inside says where the service goes: within the old car

parts.note: the Model T is an old Ford car
T is the symbol for the tesla, a unit
the RAF is one of the armed services

explanation.surface: An old Model T gets a service from Tesla at an MOT test centre.
explanation.walkthrough: Tesla evokes the car maker, fitting the car picture; it is the unit. Old Trafford in Manchester is a Test cricket ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Cricket pun: Test matches are international cricket games, and Old Trafford is one of the grounds that stages them.

clue.text: Little sister on potty lets rip a bowel movement

indicators.note: potty is British slang for crazy, so LETS RIP A goes wild and changes order

parts.note: anagram of LETS RIP A
sis is short for sister

explanation.surface: A little sister on the potty lets rip.
explanation.walkthrough: "Potty" is the child's toilet in the surface and 'mad' in the wordplay; "bowel movement" is taken literally.
explanation.definitionFit: Literal medical sense: peristalsis is the wave of muscle contractions that moves food through the bowel.
